title: Buprenorphine Dose Adjustments and Gestational Age
brief_summary: In this retrospective cohort study, we plan to examine the relationship between buprenorphine dose adjustments, gestational age, urine buprenorphine levels and the rate of neonatal abstinence syndrome in opioid-maintained pregnant women
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Pregnant
* opioid-dependent
* being treated at same location

Exclusion Criteria:

* Not pregnant
* not opioid-dependent
study_population: Ages 14-55yrs of age Female any ethnic background
